new_result.summary: For A=H^T diag(1,2,-3,4)H with normalized 4x4 Hadamard H and iid Uniform[-1/2,1/2] inputs, every spectral 3+1 split has sup_b ||p_(Q3|Qrest=b)||_infinity=infinity; at edge conditioning values the lower bound is at least 1/(18 epsilon^2). The same fixed A has ||p_Q||_infinity <=2*pi/sqrt(3) for every admissible independent cap-one coordinate law, so QFORM itself is not refuted.
